products.title: Warrior Mat - Black
products.body_html: This mat supports you literally and figuratively. Reach new levels of performance with our rigorously tested Warrior mat. Its luxe matte finish, oversized, slip-free design, and anti-odor & moisture-wicking qualities help you stay grounded through all your moves. It’s also 100% formaldehyde-free, non-toxic, and PVC-free, perfect for a clean practice and a peaceful movement session.

products.title: Power Moves Workout Gloves - Black
products.body_html: Ready for another set? The Power Moves Workout Glove is a breathable, multi-purpose athletic glove designed with heavy duty mesh and padded palms for comfort. Wear it while weight training for more support — cool cutouts prevent palms from getting sweaty so you can stay locked in.

products.title: Lightweight Warrior Mat - Smoky Quartz
products.body_html: You asked and we answered. The Warrior Mat now comes in a new lighter weight. It has the thickness and comfort of the classic Warrior Mat that you know and love, but it now comes in a lighter weight that makes it easy to go from car to class.
